paper_id: The Role of Summarization in Generative Agents_ A Preliminary Perspective
title: The Role of Summarization in Generative Agents: A Preliminary Perspective
motivation: 认为摘要能力是生成式智能体最基础且不可或缺的,现有研究缺乏从摘要视角的系统理解
problem_framing: 将生成式智能体的各功能模块(Retrieve/Reflect/Plan/Act)统一形式化为摘要任务
key_insight: summarization is the most fundamental and indispensable capacity of generative agents manifested across diverse scenarios
method_signature: 从摘要视角重帧智能体架构,枚举6类摘要技术对应各模块
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: We assume the implicit query "[name]'s previous day plan" is used... — 对Previous Day Summary的实现细节只是假设,未验证
evidence_for_taste: we believe summarization is the most fundamental
This is also in line with the previous related work
we assume the implicit query...we believe that when facing long and verbose dialogue histories
a picture is worth a thousand words
thinking_moves: 把复杂系统分解后重新用统一框架归类
用成熟NLP任务(摘要)解释新兴系统(智能体)各模块
